steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Their voices grew louder and louder, attracting some kind passers-by.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Everyone started calling out for the little critter. Their voices echoed across the whole city!

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The animals ran to the higher parts of the city, trying to carry their voices farther.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: More and more people joined. All of them wanted to help the little critter.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Not even the ducks could stop them.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Hey, still want to fight? That's what you get for bullying Stella!

steps.speaker: Obbo
steps.content:
Quack quack... Quack quack... Quack quack...
(No more... Please stop... We surrender...)

steps.speaker: Shobbo
steps.content:
Quack quack quack quack... Quack quack...
(I can't believe we got completely wiped out... I refuse to believe it...)

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: At last, the little critter arrived at the highest point in the city. It called out to the sky.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The sun... No, the rain... Not right either, let me think... I got it! The wind...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The wind carried its voice far, far away. Its family heard it, and finally came back to it!

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Hmm, the ending seems a bit off. Let me try again.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: At last, the little critter arrived at the highest point in the city. It called out to the sky with all its might...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: It... it used all its might, but the sky was so far away. Its voice couldn't reach that far. A duck climbed up and grabbed its hand...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: But the little critter refused to give up. It struggled and kept calling out, its tears splashing onto the duck's wing. At that moment...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: The curse was broken. The duck remembered everything... it was the little critter's family member all along! That's why it kept chasing the little critter! That's why...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...Still seems a bit... weird... How can the villains turn good so suddenly? Let me change it again...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: It used all its might, but the sky was so far away. Its voice couldn't echo that far.

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: A duck climbed up, but those who came to help the little critter also arrived. The duck got scared and ran away. The little critter turned around, its eyes widening...

steps.speaker: Narration
steps.content: Everyone looked a bit like the little critter itself. Could it be that the family it was looking for all this time...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Was... was... by its side... all along...
She trails off. This is the first time that the great Director OwO doesn't finish reading her own script.

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: ...I... can't figure it out...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: I want to give the little critter a happy ending, to reunite it with its family... But all these versions sound so fake. Like some story made up to fool little kids...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: Stella wouldn't believe such a movie either...

steps.speaker: OwO
steps.content: It had been alone all this time. No one ever responded to its calls... I... I...

steps.speaker: Stella
steps.content: Rrrr...
It stares at OwO, bows its head and comes to rub against OwO's hand.
